scrape.courses_parse
====================

.. py:module:: scrape.courses_parse

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Final script for parsing the course output

       Raises:
           ValueError: If the course title cannot be parsed.
           FileNotFoundError: If the allcourse.json file is not found.
           json.JSONDecodeError: If there is an error decoding the JSON file.
           Exception: If there is an error writing the parsed courses to a file.

       Returns:
           list: A list of dictionaries containing parsed course information.

----------

   scrape.courses_parse.directory_path
   scrape.courses_parse.parsed_courses

.. py:function:: parse_course_info(course_data)

   Parse course information and extract separate components.

   :param course_data: Dictionary containing course title and description
   :type course_data: dict

   :returns: Parsed course information with separated components
   :rtype: dict


.. py:function:: parse_allcourses_json(directory_path)

   Parse the allcourse.json file in the specified directory.

   :param directory_path: Path to the directory containing allcourse.json
   :type directory_path: str

   :returns: List of parsed course information
   :rtype: list
